text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... If I'd been just a teensy bit
faster...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My brain just keeps on show'n me all the
ways I
could've done better...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But I guess I'm not gonna get any faster
by sitt'n
here shilly-shally'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I didn't put in enough work, plain 'n
simple! So
I've just gotta do better
b'fore the next race!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! First, I've gotta study where I went
wrong! I
sure don't wanna be mak'n the
same mistakes
again!
choice_data_list_en: Let's get our heads back in the game!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You better buckle up, 'cause my next
race is
gonna blow your socks off!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Miss'n out on first place gave me
just the
motivation I need!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna put in a whole buncha train'n
so I'll be
all geared up and ready t'win
next time!
